Vendors - Supplemental Services and Products 
 The vendors listed below offer supplemental services and products to Open Dental customers. We do not necessarily endorse any of these companies, nor do we provide technical support for their products. If you have a negative experience with a third-party, please email service@opendental.com. 
 Click a category to view below:
Patient Communications

 Open Dental has issued warnings about some third-party companies. See Third-Party Warnings for details. It is important that any third-party you choose to work with uses a safe integration method with Open Dental. Safe integrations include native integrations, Program Links, and companies using the Open Dental API. 
 Third party vendors that work with Open Dental Software may use terminology such as "affiliated" or "partnered" with Open Dental, or that they have an "Open Dental Integration". We do not necessarily endorse any of these companies, nor do we provide technical support for their products or services. If the vendor is using the API, we do fully support that part of any integration. API integrations continue to function whether or not Open Dental customers are on support. To understand the different type of integrations, see Open Dental Integration Types. 
 Patient Communications 
These companies provide authorized integrations into Open Dental for various marketing and communication options such as texting, patient forms, scheduling, review requests, etc. 
Acrew. Transform how you connect with your patients and earn more revenue for your investment! Acrew offers a wide range of solutions such as: automated communications, efficient online scheduling, easy to use patient portal and more. Acrew is your tool to optimize time, reduce no-shows, and enhance patient satisfaction, so you can focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care. 
 Meet Axle we automate communication for confirmations, reminders, mass texting, asap messaging, automated forms and more. Axle was created to optimize your practice and consolidate vendors. Axle uses AI technology to automate tasks like insurance verification which allows your team to work more efficiently. This leads to more time focused on revenue generating activities. Axle has saved practices hundreds of thousands of dollars per year by consolidating vendors and automating things like hygiene scheduling. Axle provides 14+ features all in a single pane of glass: Watch a short demo to learn more, or schedule a call with our team by clicking here to start optimizing and savings today. YOU TREAT PATIENTS. WE OPTIMIZE YOUR PRACTICE 
Clerri is the leading care membership platform transforming how dental practices grow. By simplifying access to care through smart, sustainable membership plans, Clerri empowers providers to increase patient loyalty, reduce insurance dependence, and build recurring revenue. Trusted by over 25,000 dentists, including more than 5,000 independent offices and 200-plus group practices, Clerri delivers a clear path to practice success powered by automation, expert support, and nationwide compliance. 
Echo is an AI patient communication platform that keeps your schedule full to prevent revenue leakage. Our platform runs calls, texts, and emails intelligently on auto-pilot to reduce no-shows and cancellations. Echo handles patient intake, schedules new and existing patients, sends appointment reminders, fills cancellations, and follows up on referrals. Our natural human-like voice technology can speak nearly 70 languages including English, Spanish, Mandarin, Urdu, and more. Every interaction is HIPAA-compliant and fully documented. 
Flex Dental Solutions seamlessly integrates with Open Dental to enhance what practices can do with their existing practice management system. Flex builds on the Open Dental foundation, offering powerful tools that automate front office workflows, improve patient communication, and deliver real-time insights into practice performance. From online scheduling with Reserve with Google to automated insurance verification, 2-way texting, patented treatment planning and integrated patient payments, Flex empowers dental teams to operate more efficiently and connect with patients more effectively. By combining the reliability of Open Dental with the innovation of Flex, practices gain a smarter, more streamlined approach to growth. 
Healink is an AI-powered patient engagement and treatment coordination platform that helps dental practices convert more diagnosed treatment into completed care. Through a secure patient portal, automated follow-ups, treatment education, financing information, and appointment request workflows, Healink keeps patients engaged after they leave the office. Open Dental integration enables automatic synchronization of treatment plans and patient information with minimal staff effort. In addition to its software platform, Healink offers an outcome-based service model where trained Virtual Treatment Coordinators proactively follow up with patients who have unscheduled treatment plans, answer questions, assist with scheduling, and help practices recover lost production without adding internal staffing. 
Kasper is a event-based practice management platform for dental offices. We handle the full patient journey, starting the moment they click "Book Now" on Google through automated reminders, digital consent forms, insurance verification, and check-in. Our integrated phone system, two-way texting, and fax keep your team connected. AI-powered call intelligence summarizes every call and writes it to the patient chart automatically. At checkout, collect payments in-office or via text-to-pay. Kasper monitors your revenue cycle - flagging billing errors, wrong write-offs, unallocated payments, and calculating your monthly collection percentage. Kasper automatically detects patient issues and surfaces the right workflow to fix them on the spot. Kasper supervises every phone call with AI, evaluating topics and governance rules in real time. When standards aren't met, tasks are created and managers are alerted instantly. From filling schedule gaps with one click to automating recall reminders and payment follow-ups, Kasper turns your checklists into enforceable, automated workflows. 
LocalReviews has been helping dental clinics and businesses take control of their online reputations with the most recent, relevant, and raving reviews possible. Our suite of review-collection tools offers everything needed to collect, manage and display more 5 star reviews in more places. 
Plan Forward is a leading membership plan partner for DSOs, groups and independent practices. Membership plans are the best way to attract new patients, increase loyalty, and net production per patient. Our platform is fully integrated into the PMS, and we offer a 100% custom approach to plan pricing and marketing. For groups and DSOs, our platform permits flexibility, allowing different plans, pricing and compliance to give your practices the best outcome: profitable growth, powered by our best-in-class platform, and our expert support & plan marketing. 
Podium OD. Podium is a marketing and communication platform that helps local businesses get more reviews, convert customers, communicate faster, and increase revenue. 
Powervox Dental is an omnichannel patient communication and front-office AI platform built for Open Dental. Designed for solo practices as well as multi-location clinics and DSOs, Powervox unifies your entire patient touchpoint strategy into one platform: combining a clinic-aware 24/7 AI receptionist, online scheduling, a complete two-way SMS suite for confirmations and recalls, and digital intake forms. By automating repetitive front-desk tasks, routing multi-site communications seamlessly, and capturing every missed booking opportunity, Powervox helps dental practices increase production and deliver an elevated patient experience. 
RingDental is an AI communication platform built for dental practices using Open Dental. It answers calls 24/7, schedules appointments, captures patient information, and handles common dental questions in multiple languages so the front desk can focus on patient care. RingDental also performs outbound calls and sends SMS with location or scheduling links while capturing and managing leads from landing pages that can book directly. The platform is a unified solution connecting voice, chatbot, and SMS agents to streamline scheduling and boost profitability for the practice. 
Solutionreach provides a comprehensive patient engagement platform designed to help dental practices improve communication, streamline operations, enhance patient satisfaction, and grow revenue. With features like automated appointment reminders, digital intake forms, text-to-pay, two-way texting, and dental insurance management, Solutionreach helps practices save time, boost revenue, and deliver an exceptional patient experience. 
Weave is the all-in-one experience platform for small- and medium-sized healthcare businesses. From the first phone call to the final invoice and every touchpoint in between, Weave connects the entire customer journey. Weave's software solutions transform how local healthcare providers attract, communicate with, and engage patients to grow their practice. In the past year, Weave has been named a G2 leader in Patient Relationship Management, Patient Engagement, Optometry, and Dental Practice Management software. To learn more, visit getweave.com/newsroom 
Revenue Cycle 
These companies provide authorized integrations into Open Dental for various revenue cycle options such as patient billing, collections, insurance verification, membership plans, patient financing, etc. 
AirPay is the smarter dental benefits software that automates insurance verification and proactively flags common eligibility and coverage issues before the patient visit. Integrated directly with Open Dental, AirPay automatically verifies coverage for more than 90% of scheduled appointments and delivers detailed, structured eligibility data across 1,200+ payers. By reducing manual insurance work and surfacing actionable insurance warnings automatically, AirPay helps practices save 4+ hours each day, increase claim acceptance, and reduce average collection time by 18 days. 
Bearfoot Dental is an AI-driven voice platform that helps dental practices simplify and humanize patient billing. Our intelligent voice agent engages patients with clear, empathetic communication - clarifying balances, offering payment options, and reducing confusion - so clinics collect more while patients feel respected. Practices using Bearfoot see higher collections, reduced staff workload, and improved patient satisfaction. Every interaction is fully HIPAA, FDCPA, and PCI-DSS compliant, giving you peace of mind while enhancing your revenue cycle. 
BillNow turns the most complex revenue cycle workflows into simple, intelligent operations customized to your needs. From insurance verification and claims management to payment posting, reconciliation, and real-time practice insights, BillNow works seamlessly alongside Open Dental with little to no onboarding. You weren't meant to run a mini insurance company. 
BrandaCare - Dental Insurance Verification, Billing and A/R Team for Open Dental - BrandaCare is a month-to-month, HIPAA-compliant backend insurance team that works inside your Open Dental, with a BAA signed before day one.
 Real people, backed by AI tools, verify every patient before the visit and load what insurance will actually pay: maximums, deductibles, percentages, frequencies, history, missing tooth clause and waiting periods. When the payer portal doesn't have it, we call. Every verification carries its source, reference number and date. No rush fee, ever, for same-day patients and walk-ins.
 We also send clean claims, post payments, work denials and appeals, and recover old A/R until it is paid or closed with a reason. English and Spanish. Connected through the Open Dental API, nothing to install. Add the Automatic Eligibility Daily Check to confirm active coverage for every scheduled patient, every day. Start with a free Plan Health Check of your Open Dental. We call it Humanizing Dentistry®. 
Bravebird verifies dental eligibility and benefits end to end. We pull plan details directly from payer portals, and call the insurance when a portal is missing or incomplete, so every patient gets verified. Code-level breakdowns, history, frequencies, age limits, restrictions are all written back into Open Dental. 
CERTIFY CARE is a secure, cloud-based platform designed to streamline patient intake, improve workflows, optimize revenue cycle and enhance patient experience. Key features include: FaceCheck biometric authentication, Workflow automation, Manage Waitlist with analysis, Patient journey insights, Automated payments, Ensures compliance (HITRUST, SOC II, PCI-DSS), and Offers flexible integration. CERTIFY CARE enhances operations, security, and care delivery through automation and seamless communication. 
Clear Dental Billing is an outsourced dental billing company whose US-based team handles insurance verification, claims, denials, and patient billing for practices. 
Crystal Clear Billing Solutions delivers expert remote dental billing, optimizing insurance revenue - one claim at a time. Each practice works with a dedicated billing specialist with over 12 years of experience, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and maximum reimbursements. We manage your full revenue cycle, giving you a smoother workflow, higher collections, and complete confidence in your financial performance. Our quality-over-quantity approach guarantees focused attention for every client and meticulous care for every claim - because your success is our priority. 
Customer Care Global is an accounts receivable management and capital recovery firm committed to providing unparalleled service to clients and consumers alike. 
DayDream helps practices put dental billing on auto-pilot. From insurance verification to claim submission to payment posting, DayDream combines US-based experts with cutting-edge technology to help practices automate billing 
Dental Claim Support (DCS), founded in 2012, is a trusted dental billing partner for private practices, groups, DSOs, and oral surgery offices. Our mission: help you reclaim the revenue you've earned and give your team more time for patient care. DCS' vetted billing experts partner directly with your team to provide Insurance Billing, Insurance Verification, Oral Surgery Billing, Credentialing, and Special AR Projects. By combining powerful AI and automation with seasoned human expertise, DCS delivers a hands-on partnership focused on increasing your revenue. To learn more, book a free 30-minute consultation with DCS. 
Dental Payz. Completely Automated Accounts Receivable with easy payments by SMS & Email. Supports split payment schedules for procedures like Implants & Crowns. 
DentalRobot. Insurance Verification AI Automation for Dental Offices and Dental Support Organizations. Start with Dental Insurance Verification Automation AI. One Dental Automation Platform, unlimited workflows. Automate up to 93% of your dental insurance verification workflow. Lower dental revenue cycle costs by up to 70%. 
DentalXChange's Dental Billing Services supplements your practice with the benefit of extra staff without any additional administrative overhead. Let us handle the tedious tasks freeing them to focus on patient care. Since 2014, our Dental Billing Services have managed common office tasks such as Payment Posting, Claim Submission, Claim Follow Up and Benefit Verification with data entry creating new efficiencies leading to higher patient satisfaction and cost savings. 
Foji automates insurance enrollment and real-time benefits verification through its AI agent, fully integrated with Open Dental. Practices can instantly verify eligibility, co-pays, deductibles, and coverage details directly from payer sources, with results written back into Open Dental - eliminating manual data entry and portal logins. The solution helps reduce claim denials, streamline front-desk workflows, and accelerate collections by flagging pre-authorizations and ensuring accurate insurance information is always on file. Setup is fast, with no-code integration and HIPAA-compliant audit trails built in. 
Foresee Health is trusted by hundreds of billing companies, DSOs, and medical practices to supercharge cash flow and streamline patient billing. Our AI systems integrate seamlessly with Open Dental, making patient billing and payments relevant to today's world. Our platform provides simple, easy-to-understand digital patient accounts for all statements and modern payment options like Apple Pay and customized payment plans, helping clinics get paid faster and improving cash flow. With no contracts and a 60-day free trial, we empower healthcare providers to boost revenue, with some clients earning up to $20K more per month. Transform your billing operations with AI today! 
 Dedicated remote team members for dental practices. KMC hires and manages front desk, scheduling, insurance verification and billing staff in the Philippines who work in your Open Dental like in-office staff, at a fraction of the cost. 
 Transform how your patients say yes to treatment and watch your revenue grow! Lemur connects your dental office to multiple financing sources through a single, seamless platform integrated with Open Dental - offering the best possible terms for every patient, across every credit profile. Lemur is your tool to maximize treatment acceptance, eliminate turned-away cases, and take on zero financial risk - so you can focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care. 
Mintara | Insurance Payment Posting & AI Dental Scribe helps dental practices save time on insurance payment posting and clinical documentation with two AI-powered solutions integrated with Open Dental.
 Insurance Payment Posting: Automate paper and PDF EOB processing without requiring EFT or ERA enrollment. Mintara reads EOBs from major and smaller insurance payers, including varied formats, extracts payment details, matches claims and procedures, and prepares payments for review and posting in Open Dental. In tested workflows, Mintara has processed 20+ EOBs in under a minute.
 AI Dental Scribe: Record the full patient visit or simply dictate a quick, conversational summary afterward. Mintara understands natural dental dictation and transforms it into structured clinical notes and insurance narratives, ready for review and approval in Open Dental. In one dentist's experience, a 30-60-second dictation replaces 2-4 minutes of typing, with notes requiring corrections only about 1% of the time. 
myMedCrew is a managed staffing company for US dental practices. We source, vet and place remote dental billing, insurance verification, credentialing and front desk staff for independent and multi-location practices, and the crew works directly inside your Open Dental database. Your practice directs the day-to-day work, while we own sourcing, vetting, payroll and HIPAA-aligned compliance. 
Premium Insurance Billing delivers expert remote dental billing nationwide with Open Dental. We handle full service billing including claims submission, payment posting, denial management, and accounts receivable follow-up, as well as standalone or bundled A/R cleanup and insurance verification. What sets us apart is live chat access to your dedicated billing and verification specialists, so your office receives immediate answers and support in real time. Our experienced team ensures accuracy, compliance, and faster reimbursements while reducing administrative burden. From small offices to multi-provider practices, Premium Insurance Billing combines human expertise with streamlined workflows to improve collections, accelerate cash flow, and give your team more time for what matters most, caring for patients.
Remote Sourcing is a 100% U.S. based dental billing and revenue cycle team working directly inside your Open Dental database. We handle insurance claims, payment posting, AR follow-up, peer review, insurance verification, and credentialing, so your front desk can focus on patients. Built by clinicians and billing specialists who treat your collections like our own.
Secure Dental Solutions goes beyond outsourced dental billing by combining hands-on revenue cycle management with revenue intelligence and strategic oversight. We manage the day-to-day work - clean claim submission, insurance A/R recovery, appeals, payment posting, insurance verification, patient billing, and credentialing - while also helping practices understand what is happening behind their numbers.
 Through proactive account monitoring, revenue trend analysis, and customized Revenue Intelligence reporting, SDS identifies collection gaps, aging trends, denial patterns, workflow breakdowns, and opportunities for improvement before they become larger revenue problems.
 Our team doesn't simply work the billing queue; we help practices strengthen the systems driving their revenue. From claim submission to financial insight, Secure Dental Solutions helps dental practices protect what they've earned, recover what's outstanding, and make better-informed revenue decisions. 
Smile Care Claims. We know dentistry. That's why we're good at insurance. Dental insurance billing, benefit verification, claims follow-up, posting, and A/R recovery. A dedicated account manager who knows your office and your software. Denials get worked, not written off. Old claims get chased, not abandoned. Published pricing. Let us deal with the insurance companies. Your team can focus on patients.
Solv Billing provides professional dental billing services nationwide. We help practices simplify billing, eliminate denials, and collect more revenue. We Don't Just Bill - We Build Healthier Cashflow.
Star Dental Solutions is a trusted dental billing partner referred by dentists nationwide. Our U.S.-based, tenured billing professionals manage the insurance revenue cycle within Open Dental-from clean claim submission and insurance follow-up through appeals, accurate payment posting, and adjustments-helping practices protect the revenue they've earned. Additional services include patient A/R management to help practices collect every dollar they've earned, along with insurance verification where detailed coverage breakdowns are updated and documented directly within Open Dental for each patient reviewed, ensuring treatment plans can be created and presented with greater confidence. To learn more about partnering with Star Dental Solutions, schedule a complimentary discovery call. 
Subscribili offers a fully integrated and customizable subscription platform that drives recurring revenue and increases patient loyalty. Patients on a subscription plan are 25% more likely to return for care and 3 times more likely to accept treatment compared to uninsured patients. A subscription plan program attracts new patients, retains them longer, and significantly increases your bottom line. DMPO and TPA licensed as well as SOC2 certified, we take compliance and security seriously. Our Ascend integration simplifies your workflows and ensures plan benefits are provided and tracked seamlessly.
Root Data is an AI-powered optimization layer for your dental practice, built to turn the data already sitting in your dental software into clear, actionable insights that increase revenue and operational efficiency. Root Data connects directly to Open Dental and monitors the full picture of practice performance in real time, including production, collections, hygiene, scheduling, case acceptance, marketing, new patient flow, and dozens of other dental metrics, then surfaces the revenue leaks quietly costing your practice money and tells you exactly what to do next. Designed for both single practice owners and dental support organizations, Root Data delivers the same operator-grade dental analytics that large groups rely on, without requiring you or your team to become data analysts. Instead of static reports, every meaningful change is explained in context, prioritized by financial impact, and paired with a clear next action. With AI coaching layered on top of your existing systems, Root Data helps practices of every size find recoverable revenue, tighten operations, and grow with confidence. 
Todd Dental Operations is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) focused on revenue recovery systems built on top of Open Dental. We help practices identify and act on lost revenue opportunities such as unscheduled treatment, missed appointments, and inactive patients. The platform executes structured follow-up workflows to improve patient reactivation, increase case acceptance, and strengthen operational performance. 
TSI & Open Dental work together to offer dental practices an integrated collection process. With a click of a mouse practices have the ability from within Open Dental to view, select and administer accounts that require additional 1st party followup appearing to be from the practice, 3rd party reminder notices or 3rd party collection services by TSI. 
 TSI recovers 3x more money for 1/3 the cost of others agencies, resulting in $400 million dollars recovered for over 5,500 dental practices. 
 Sign Up for TSI - https://tsico.com/alliances-opendental/ 
View eliminates manual payment posting by automatically processing EOBs and ERAs, posting adjustments, and flagging underpayments - all directly inside Open Dental. It also streamlines insurance verification and fee schedule management, helping dental practices and billing companies reduce data entry and catch revenue leaks before they add up. 
VoiceCare AI uses state-of-the-art generative voice AI technology to handle millions of inbound and outbound calls each year. Our HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II attested platform is deeply integrated with Open Dental to automate 95% of routine calls, including benefit breakdowns, estimates, claims follow-ups, appeals, denials, appointment scheduling, FAQs, and more. By minimizing call wait times and easing administrative workloads, we supercharge your staff to focus on high-touch patient interactions. Built for accuracy, efficiency, and scalability, VoiceCare AI ensures your practice delivers reliable, multilingual patient and payer communication-day or night, delivering effective patient care. 
Zen Dental Support brings calm and clarity to the chaos of dental revenue cycles. We help dental practices streamline and strengthen their revenue cycle management so they get paid faster, more consistently, and with less stress. We specialize in insurance verifications, claim submission, attachments, A/R management and appeals-while also training teams to improve documentation, reduce denials, and protect revenue from the start. At the core, we bridge the gap between clinical care and administrative processes so your practice can operate more smoothly, efficiently, and with intention. 
 Your reliable dental billing outsourcing company-Zealous. Our team helps dental offices recover more revenue, lower A/R, and receive dental insurance payments faster. Outsource your dental billing to our team of experts that feel like a seamless extension of your team! Our core services include clean claim submission, accurate payment posting and aging report cleanup. We also have customizable add on services available such as: navigating network and fee schedule negotiations, insurance verification, fee schedule updates, and credentialing assistance. 
Zeldent is a revenue integrity platform that protects dental practices from embezzlement, payment fraud, and revenue leakage. Integrated directly with Open Dental, Zeldent continuously monitors ledgers, adjustments, write-offs, and payment activity to surface suspicious patterns the moment they appear. Instead of waiting for a year-end surprise or a manual audit, owners get clear, prioritized alerts that pinpoint exactly where money is slipping away. Zeldent helps practices recover lost revenue, tighten financial controls, and operate with confidence. Built for single-location owners, group practices, and DSOs, it delivers automated daily oversight without adding work for your team. Every connection is secure and HIPAA compliant. Protect the revenue you have already earned with Zeldent. 
Zentist's flagship product, Remit AI, automates payment posting by matching payments to procedures and claims, eliminating the need for manual data entry. Seamlessly integrated with Open Dental through its API, it enables accuracy, faster reconciliation, and cleaner billing records - all directly within your PMS. Dental groups and DSOs can process payments significantly faster while reducing errors and administrative workload. 
Business Intelligence Dashboards & KPIs
These companies read Open Dental data to measure performance. 
BlueIQ . Track what matters most, know the minute you need to take action. With a single, intuitive dashboard containing all your business data from your Practice Management System, Facebook, Google Analytics, Quickbooks, and more, you can make brilliant decisions in seconds; from custom, automated reports that align your goals with real-time performance, to customized alerts that notify you when your business needs your attention. BlueIQ is a dental dashboard that goes beyond traditional business intelligence to create a data-driven culture where each team member is engaged and values their contribution. 
Clarifi Healthcare is a performance and operations platform built for dental organizations. We unify data from practice management, EHR, revenue cycle, and financial systems to provide clear, real-time visibility across every location and provider. Clarifi turns fragmented data into practical insights that improve production, collections, scheduling efficiency, and patient flow. Designed for DSOs, group practices, and growth-focused private practices, Clarifi helps clinical and operational teams work in alignment. With standardized scorecards, operational dashboards, and workflow tools, organizations can drive accountability, improve execution, and consistently deliver excellent patient care while scaling with confidence. 
  DentFlow Systems is a custom software development firm built exclusively for dental practices that want more clarity, control, and efficiency in their operations. Our flagship AI-powered KPI Dashboard transforms your data into actionable insights. Simply describe the metric you want in plain language, and our system generates the KPI for you using data from Open Dental and QuickBooks. No manual report building. No complex setup. Just instant visibility into the numbers that matter most. Beyond dashboards, we design intelligent automations that streamline reporting, eliminate repetitive tasks, and optimize workflows - helping dental offices save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions with confidence. DentFlow Systems turns your practice data into a strategic advantage. 
OS Dental is a dental intelligence platform that unifies data from PMS, accounting, HR, marketing, and other operational systems into a single analytics layer for practices and DSOs. By connecting these data sources, OS Dental provides clear, actionable insights across financial performance, provider productivity, patient flow, and marketing ROI. Instead of juggling multiple reports and systems, teams get one connected view of the business - helping them identify opportunities, improve operational efficiency, and make faster, data-driven decisions. 
Smile Data: Unlike generic analytics platforms trying to serve every practice management system, Smile Data was created by dental industry veterans - practicing dentists and operation experts with 15+ years scaling practices to 200+ locations. We know exactly what drives practice performance. This is not just another reporting platform - it's a co-pilot meant to serve the front office team and the "CEO Dentist" to use Open Dental to its maximum capabilities. Our exclusive Open Dental focus means perfect data accuracy with hourly updates and features designed for real-world workflow efficiency: identify which insurance claims need follow-up today (not outdated 30-60-90 day buckets), pinpoint high-priority treatments to fill your schedule immediately, and track hygiene drop-offs and treatment conversion opportunities (all automated). We keep it simple: month-to-month billing, no contracts, no integration fees, no setup costs. Just unlimited users, great support, and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Start using analytics built by people who've managed practices (and still own practices) just like yours. 
Merchant Services 
These companies offer authorized methods of integrating payment processing into Open Dental. 
Apex Payment Solutions was cofounded by a dentist who saw firsthand the need for more transparent, cost-effective payment processing in dental practices. That same experience led to Apex Integrated, a payment platform built by dental teams, for dental teams. As an authorized Open Dental integrated partner, Apex Integrated brings payments directly into the patient workflow with automatic ledger posting, digital treatment and payment plans, secure patient payment tools, and streamlined reporting. It is designed to reduce manual work, simplify payments, and help dental teams operate more efficiently, all while helping practices keep payment processing costs down. 
Fintu brings your Open Dental to your browser and your phone. Manage the office from anywhere! Patient payments are fully integrated and incredibly easy, with an additional suite of built in features such as texting and appointment reminders, metrics and dashboards, insurance, phones, and more. We can have you running live in about an hour. 
Moolah is a modern dental payment platform built specifically for practices using Open Dental. As an authorized integrated partner, Moolah seamlessly connects payments directly into the patient ledger, eliminating manual entry and streamlining front-office workflows. The platform combines powerful payment technology with simple flat rates, no monthly fees, free hardware, and no long-term contracts - along with features like in-office terminals, card-on-file, payment plans, membership management, electronic payment requests, and tools that streamline processing EOB payments. 
Phone Integrations 
These companies have a phone integrations (e.g., VOIP, etc). 
 AI First company - FSD of Dental Business. Revolutionize the way you connect with your Patients, Team and Vendors. AI driven integrated communications brings all parts of your organization moving smoothly. Nothing slips through the cracks. Let our proprietary AI navigate through communication clutter and get you to reach the practice goal every single week, every single month and every single year. DentalPaas is a Platform for Dental offices to get a variety of AI driven business and software services. Business Services - Scheduling, Eligibility and Breakdown, Submitting Claims, Revenue Cycle Mgt (Processing EOBs, Processing Outstanding Claims), Lab Case Coordination, Process Quality controls, Patient Engagement through Recare, Pending Treatment, reactivation, Digital Marketing - design, run and maintain google ads, Print and distribute flyers, Onsite Marketing your dental services to primary care clinics. 
VoiceStack is an AI-powered phone intelligence platform built for dental practices, turning every patient call into insights, action, and revenue. With real-time AI transcriptions, instant missed-call alerts, call scoring, and revenue-linked analytics, it shows exactly where opportunities are won or lost. No more blind spots, no more missed patients. Just a smarter, data-driven front desk from day one. 
Dental Charting & Clinical Systems 
These companies offer dental charting and other clinical systems that use an authorized method of interacting with Open Dental. 
AnalyzeCeph is a cephalometric service platform that connects dentists, who work on orthodontic cases, and cephalometric tracing providers, in a secure, HIPAA compliant fashion. 
Avora is an AI platform that records appointments and turns them into concise clinical documentation. We work with existing auto-note templates within OpenDental and save teams up to 3 hours per day. Avora also gives AI feedback on case presentation so you can coach your team on case acceptance. 
Dentin.ai offers an AI dentistry platform to boost case acceptance, save chairside time, and enhance DSO performance. Key features include Vox Natural Charting for hands-free charting of exams and perio using voice commands, and Logos Treatment Coordinator, an AI assistant for expert patient consultations and 3D case presentations in multiple languages. The platform also provides Oculus(Dei) Analytics for tracking revenue and behavior, and the Hermes Command Center for DSOs to manage processes, ensure compliance, and automate training across multiple locations. 
Friction Free Dental. Faster, Smarter, Connected. 
 Experience a state-of-the-art clinical workspace seamlessly integrated with Open Dental. FFD Clinical Suite brings AI-powered clinical notes, perio, imaging, charting, scheduling, and collaboration together in one intuitive, connected clinical user experience across desktop, iPhone, and iPad.
 FFD gives your practice a simple way to bring the power and benefits of AI to your clinical team without changing Open Dental or the imaging systems you already use. Get started with a free 30-day trial at www.ffd.ai. 
Soulware Dental Scribe is voice charting built by a practicing dentist. It's fully customizable, so it charts like your best assistant. Click "DS Charting" and just talk. Say "extract 8, graft, and replace with an implant," and it plans the extraction, bone graft, membrane, implant, CBCT, and surgical guide, along with the stock or custom abutment and implant crown according to your defaults. Treatment shows up in a floating window, and you can correct anything by voice or mouse. Click "DS Perio" for voice perio, which includes a heads-up display that's easy to read from a distance. No PHI goes through our servers. $149/month per office for charting and perio, unlimited providers, or perio alone for $49/month. Free trial, no card required. 
VELMENI One brings 2D, 3D capabilities, and Voice AI - all in one seamless clinical platform. Experience FDA-cleared 2D detection with effortless patient education, instant CBCT quality verification, and integrated claims validation that reduces denials and accelerates revenue. Save time. Save money. Elevate your practice. 
Cloud Hosting
